plugins.name: File Sorter
plugins.description: Recursively scans a folder for FITS files and groups them in tabs by instrument. Non-science files (IMAGETYP other than SCIENCE) and files without a TCSTGT target go to their own per-instrument CALIB tabs. Friendlier column labels (TARGET, IMAGETYPE, OBSMODE, FASU A/B, GRISM, FIBER). Select a range of rows to create a session-only AMPA sequence. Double-click a file to load it into the AMPA viewer.
plugins.author: samgrund
